wind_solar.source: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform, items 14.1.D (day-ahead forecast of wind and solar generation) and 16.1.B&C (actual generation per production type)
wind_solar.error: actual minus forecast, in MW; hourly means
wind_solar.known_issue: TenneT NL notice on the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform: the actual generation covers only what can be identified per fuel type (the rest is published as "other" or not at all), and solar is mostly not available. The day-ahead forecast does not match that split: since at least Oct 2026 it puts most of the wind onshore, while the actual puts most of it offshore, and the actual solar is a small part of the forecast. The error of each technology shows that difference, not the quality of the forecast.
